title: Tumi a Ɛdi Akyi a Wɔka
intro: Tete no, ankorankoro bi a ɔwɔ tumi sɔre dii asase kɛse bi ne emufo so. Na ahantan kɛse ne ɔsoro tumidi ho asɛnnennen a emu dɔ na ɛhyɛɛ saa onipa yi ahenni agyirae. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛda ɔkra bi a ne nkrabea a etwa to no bɛyɛɛ asuade a ɛtra hɔ daa maa awo ntoatoaso nyinaa no nipasu adi.
clues: Midii tumi wɔ ahemman a ɛyɛ den so, baabi a na m’asɛm yɛ mmara.
Mepaee mu kae sɛ meyɛ onyame a ɔkorɔn sen biara, na mehwehwɛɛ ɔsom fi wɔn a wɔwɔ m’ahenni ase nyinaa hɔ.
Mehyɛɛ ɔmanfo pɔtee bi so, de wɔn yɛɛ nkoa na mehyɛɛ sɛ wonkum wɔn mmarima nkokoaa.
Mihyiaa Onyankopɔn somafo a ɔbrɛ ne ho ase, a ɔyɛɛ anwonwade ahorow a emu da hɔ wɔ me ne m’akɔmfo no anim mpɛn pii.
Mede atirimɔden pow nokware no, na mebɔɔ ​​ɔbɔfo no sobo sɛ ɔyɛ nkonyaayi na mebɔɔ ​​pɔw sɛ mɛsɛe ɔne n’akyidifo.
Ɛpo no kataa me ne m’asraafo nyinaa so bere a na yɛtaa wɔn a wɔade wɔn ho afi me nsam no akyi a yɛannyae no.

outcome.answer: Nipadua a wɔakora so sɛ sɛnkyerɛnne

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
